note: Web sweep, 23 Nov 2026. Each event was read on the organiser's page, an official ticket platform (Shows.ng, Tix Africa, Eventbrite, Selar) or a named news report. Events already on the site were left out. Check again before approving.

items.name: Asake at Future Fest '26
items.venue: Oasis Ground, Coastal Road, Victoria Island
items.fee: Ticketed: prices not confirmed by the organiser
items.about: Asake headlines the closing night of Future Fest '26, a ten-day festival running 11 to 20 December. Ticket prices circulating online have not been confirmed by the organiser. Source: pulse.ng/story/asake-lagos-concert-future-fest-2026-2026111212324356431

items.name: GTCO Food & Drink Festival 2026
items.about: Guaranty Trust's annual food and drink festival with vendors and masterclasses. The official page says attendance is free; it does not name the venue yet. Source: foodanddrink.gtcoplc.com

items.name: The Capital Food Fest 2026
items.venue: Harrow Park, Ahmadu Bello Way, Wuse 2
items.fee: Check with organiser: listed as free and as ₦2,000 online / ₦5,000 at the gate
items.about: An afternoon food festival in Harrow Park. The listing gives conflicting entry details (free in one place, ₦2,000 online or ₦5,000 at the gate in another). Source: visitabuja.org/event/the-capital-food-fest-2026/

items.name: Frame Fest Abuja 2026: The Art of Character Building
items.venue: Evelyn's Event & Recreational Centre, 1st Avenue, Gwarimpa
items.about: A one-day festival for comic, animation and gaming fans built around stories rooted in Nigerian culture: talks, a gaming zone, cosplay and creator meet-ups. Organised by Symphonii Studios. Source: visitabuja.org/event/frame-fest-abuja-2026-the-art-of-character-building/

items.name: Insidetrack Abuja Christmas Bazaar & Pop-Up Shop
items.venue: FCT Exhibition Pavilion, Herbert Macaulay Way, Central Area
items.about: Christmas edition of the Insidetrack bazaar with Abuja makers selling skincare, clothing, adire, art, candles and gifts made in Nigeria. Visitor entry fee not stated. Source: visitabuja.org/event/insidetrack-abuja-christmas-bazaar-pop-up-shop/
